name: c01-flight-cheapest-window
intent: Find the cheapest time in the next 12 months for a round trip from Atlanta (ATL) to Lima (LIM), staying 7 to 14 days. Say whether any nonstop exists; if none, say so and give the cheapest one-stop option. Give the month, example dates and the price.
hard_part: Picking the right tool (fare calendar) instead of dozens of browser searches; honest "no nonstop" answer

answer_check.description: A month, a $ price, and a clear nonstop yes/no

live_stops_before: any sign-in, account creation, add-to-cart, reservation, booking, payment, consent, CAPTCHA or bot check, and every final/commit/protected button
